titleFront: They Have No Idea We're Coming
titleBack: Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent

flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToBack.prose: Flip if you CONTROL two Scarif locations (any Scarif locations - system or sites; plain control, no actor filter).

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you do NOT OCCUPY two Scarif locations, UNLESS Rogue One is at a Scarif site you occupy (spot exception).

children.req: canSpot card at qualifying location (starship exception)

requirementSemantics: Front flip = plain CONTROL 2 Scarif locations; back hold = weaker plain OCCUPY 2 Scarif locations (control-vs-occupy asymmetry favors staying on back).
Back-hold exception = CARD-AT-LOCATION spot: Rogue One (starship, landed at a site) at a Scarif SITE you occupy keeps the back up alone.
All checks INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE; no captive override (captives do not occupy).
typedIdentities: Filters.Scarif_location - flip gate both sides (locations: system + sites)
Filters.and(Filters.site, Filters.Scarif_location, Filters.occupies(self.getOwner())) - back exception site scope
Filters.Scarif_system, Filters.DataVault, Filters.Stardust, Filters.Massassi_War_Room - setup deploys
Filters.or(Filters.Rogue_One, Filters.corvette, Filters.Scarif_site) - front once-per-turn download
Filters.or(Filters.Chirrut, Filters.Baze) and Filters.and(Filters.Rebel, Filters.trooper) - granted Keyword.SPY for remainder of game
Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.title(Title.Taking_Them_With_Us)) - deploy ban for remainder of game

Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.spy) - back buff scope; Filters.hasAttached(Filters.Stardust) - back drain-protect enabler; Filters.and(Filters.Rebel, Filters.spy, Filters.not(Filters.undercover_spy)) - back weapon-targeting cancel scope
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (front, required): deploy Scarif system from Reserve Deck. Card209_029.java:53-59
Setup (front, required): deploy Data Vault from Reserve Deck (Filters.DataVault). Card209_029.java:60-66
Setup (front, required): deploy Stardust from Reserve Deck (per printed text, to Data Vault). Card209_029.java:67-73
Setup (front, required): deploy Massassi War Room from Reserve Deck. Card209_029.java:74-80

Front only, once per turn (GameTextActionId.THEY_HAVE_NO_IDEA_WERE_COMING__DOWNLOAD_SITE_OR_STARSHIP): download Rogue One, a corvette, or a Scarif site from Reserve Deck. NOTE: this download does NOT exist on the back - pull Rogue One BEFORE flipping. Card209_029.java:109-135
otherObligations: For remainder of game (front, after deployment completes): Baze, Chirrut, and Rebel troopers are spies; you may not deploy Jedi or Taking Them With Us. Card209_029.java:85-105
Back: your spies are defense value +2, power +1 if with Stardust, immune to Undercover. Card209_029_BACK.java:69-72
Back: while Stardust is ON one of your spies (hasAttached), opponent may not cancel your Force drains at battlegrounds. Card209_029_BACK.java:75-77

Back, once per turn (shared action id): place a Rebel from Lost Pile out of play to EITHER make a regular move with your Rebel spy during your control phase OR cancel an attempt to target your non-Undercover Rebel spy with a weapon. Card209_029_BACK.java:84-173
Strategic: front download is the only objective route for Rogue One/corvette/Scarif sites; back survival can rest entirely on Rogue One parked at an occupied Scarif site.
